name: PU3DPassCard
description: Hardware-accelerated WebGL render of the Purple WiFi Pass using Three.js + React Three Fiber. Displays the card with a matte-shine material, metallic edge ring, and rounded corners matching credit card proportions. Supports drag-to-orbit and auto-rotation. Loaded client-side only — zero SSR bundle impact.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Slowly auto-rotate the card on its Y-axis.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Allow the user to click and drag to orbit the card freely in 3D.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class name applied to the outer container div.
